scientific_integrity.detail: Relative claims are conditioned on load anchors; FDR, effect-size, sensitivity, and anti-cherry-picking safeguards are explicit.

practice_boundaries.detail: Community-level research workflow only; no clinical or prescriptive claim.

methodological_ground.detail: Cross-sectional and repeated-measures MaAsLin2 designs are now explicitly separated.

code_usability.detail: Archived panel regression and two fresh MaAsLin2 tests completed.

functional_suitability.note: Runnable or bounded examples cover named routes; MaAsLin2 now returns usable cross-sectional rows.

reliability.note: The degenerate random-effect error is prevented and documented.

performance_context.note: Filtering, Monte-Carlo defaults, and optional graphics are bounded.

agent_usability.note: Orientation, design eligibility, output, and failure boundaries are explicit.

human_usability.note: Dense but supported by a quick-start and decision table.

security.note: No credentials, destructive actions, or data export behavior.

maintainability.note: Cross-sectional default and repeated-measures escape hatch share one invariant.

agent_specific.note: Seeded execution and explicit guardrails make failure recovery actionable.
